entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I want to return these absolutely awful cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number?
The name is Michael Sterling, order number 88-V-F-7-2-9. And don't just 'look into it.' I want a refund. These shoes gave me the worst blisters I've ever had. They're garbage.

Thank you, Mr. Sterling. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloPro Spin Class Shoes, delivered on November 23rd. I'm sorry about the blisters. Just so I can properly document this, is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a sizing or preference issue?

Are you kidding me? I don't care what you call it! The cleats are impossible to adjust, and the shoes chew up my feet. I'm not answering your checklist questions. Get me a manager. I want to talk to someone who can actually process a refund, not waste my time.
I understand your frustration, Mr. Sterling, and I am empowered to handle returns and refunds. There's no need for a manager. I just need to confirm the details to proceed.

Proceed? Then proceed! If I don't see a return label in my inbox in the next five minutes, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. My cycling club will hear all about this.

I assure you that won't be necessary. Let me just check our policy. One moment... Okay, I see here that you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Well, it's about time. So what happens now?

I've just initiated the return. You will receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your original payment method will be credited. The refund should appear within 3-5 business days after that.
Fine. Make sure it's a full refund.

It will be, yes. And Mr. Sterling, I see you're one of our VIP members. For the trouble this has caused, especially with the blisters and the issue with the cleats, I'd like to add a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for a future purchase. We do value your business, and I want to make this right.
Oh. Okay. A $50 credit? That's... well, that's better. I appreciate that, Alex. Thank you.
You're very welcome. The credit has been applied and is ready whenever you are. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just the return and the credit. Thank you.
Perfect. Have a great day, Mr. Sterling.
